apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 206 adds NVIDIA Image Scaling (NIS). Enable Upscaling and choose NIS in Settings → Stream or HUD → Picture. Supports near-native scaling with integrated sharpening, SDR and HDR. Retains Metal 4 pacing, controller/rumble and live resolution changes. GPU checks and Release build passed; one existing UI timing test needed a retry. Device performance needs testing. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
